about: Learner languages. To add or swap a language, copy one block, change the code and names, and translate the ui strings. Any ui string you leave out falls back to English. Set dir to rtl for Dari, Farsi, Arabic, or Urdu.

english_ui.scan_form: Take a photo of a form
english_ui.scan_hint: Hold your phone above the paper. Make sure all the words are in the photo.
english_ui.ask_teacher: Ask your teacher about these words:
english_ui.no_terms: We did not find healthcare words on this form.
english_ui.unreadable: We could not read this photo. Please take a new photo with more light.
english_ui.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
english_ui.headphones_tip: Use headphones if you can. You can use a pretend name.
english_ui.fill_blank: Which word goes in the blank?
english_ui.talk_unavailable: Talking practice is not set up yet. Ask your teacher.
english_ui.scan_unavailable: Photo reading is not set up yet. Ask your teacher.
